heroText: We study bacteria that live alongside the soil amoeba Dictyostelium discoideum, a predator that feeds on bacteria, to understand why some microbes evolve into symbionts while others become pathogens.

highlights.title: Predation resistance
highlights.text: How free-living Pseudomonas survive being eaten, and what that costs them.

highlights.title: Symbiosis & virulence
highlights.text: How Paraburkholderia moved from surviving digestion to living inside its host.

highlights.title: Molecular mechanisms
highlights.text: Comparative genomics, transcriptomics, and transposon mutagenesis to find the genes that matter.

joinText: We're looking for graduate students, postdocs, and undergraduates curious about the line between predator, prey, pathogen, and partner.
